speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are concerned about your 8-month-old son's feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. Can you tell me more about his bowel habits, specifically how often he passes stool and what the consistency is like?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does he pass any stool, and if so, is it bloody or mucousy? Has he experienced any episodes of projectile vomiting or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: There has not been fever, vomiting, or diarrhea like a stomach infection. The baby was born at 39 weeks without birth complications.

speaker: Doctor
text: Is the baby passing any stool, and if so, what is its consistency and color? Have you noticed if he cries excessively when his abdomen is touched or after feeds?

speaker: Patient
